title: Dark Green Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies eligibility and usage requirements for the Dark Green account: primary holder must be at least 17 and you can maintain the account through age 26. It lists fees ($10 monthly maintenance, foreign ATM 2.5% capped at $6, returned deposit $10, incoming domestic wire $7.50) plus debit card/ATM limits ($1,500 daily purchases, $300 daily ATM withdrawals).
faqs: What are the eligibility requirements for the Dark Green account (age limits)?
What fees apply to the Dark Green account, including monthly maintenance, returned deposits, and domestic wire fees?
How much do foreign ATM withdrawals cost, and what is the $6.00 per-transaction cap?
